title: Pure Flower Cardian
summary: Flower Cardian cards only, with a few hand traps and generic Links. Flower Cardians are DARK Warriors that draw a card and show it, and reward you only when it's another Flower Cardian. So the Main Deck is almost all Flower Cardian monsters, and other cards are kept to six. The "with" Cardians are summoned by tributing another Cardian (Pine, Zebra Grass, Willow and Paulownia need one of the same Level), then draw and summon the next one. Flower Gathering summons four 100-ATK Cardians from the Deck at once, and Flower Stacking sets the top of the Deck. Flower Cardian Cherry Blossom, the newest (2020), summons itself next to a Level 2 or lower Cardian and tributes one to draw into a Deck search. Super All In!, from the same year, returns a Synchro to summon four Cardians from the GY. Peony with Butterfly, Willow with Calligrapher and Moonflowerviewing make every Synchro material Level 2. That opens Flower Cardian Lightflare, which needs five materials and negates Spells and Traps, and Lightshower, which protects your Cardians. Most Cardian summons lock you to Flower Cardians for the turn.
main: Flower Cardian Pine
Level 1: draws when Normal Summoned; Pine with Crane tributes it.
Flower Cardian Pine with Crane
Tributes a Level 1 Cardian to summon itself and draw into the next one.
Flower Cardian Cherry Blossom
Newest: summons itself next to a small Cardian; tributes one to draw and search.
Flower Cardian Cherry Blossom with Curtain
Reveals itself to draw; summons itself if the draw is a Cardian.
Flower Cardian Zebra Grass
Level 8: summons itself next to a smaller Cardian; shuffles Cardians back to draw.
Flower Cardian Zebra Grass with Moon
Tributes a Level 8 Cardian to summon itself and draw.
Flower Cardian Willow
Level 11: summons itself next to a smaller Cardian; recycles one to draw.
Flower Cardian Willow with Calligrapher
Tuner: tributes a Level 11 Cardian; makes Synchro materials Level 2.
Flower Cardian Paulownia
Level 12: summons itself next to a smaller Cardian; stops an attack.
Flower Cardian Paulownia with Phoenix
Tributes a Level 12 Cardian to summon itself and draw.
Flower Cardian Peony with Butterfly
Tuner: tributes any Cardian; makes Synchro materials Level 2.
Flower Cardian Clover with Boar
Tributes any Cardian; destroys a monster on a Cardian draw.
Flower Cardian Maple with Deer
Tributes any Cardian; destroys a Spell/Trap on a Cardian draw.
Flower Gathering
Summons four 100-ATK Cardians with different names from the Deck.
Flower Stacking
Stacks three Cardians on top of the Deck; recovers one from the GY.
Recardination
Recovers a Cardian and summons one from the hand.
Super All In!
Newest: returns a Synchro to summon four Cardians from the GY.
Super Koi Koi
Excavates three and summons every Cardian among them.
extra: Level 10 from five materials: negates their Spells and Traps.
Level 8 from four materials: protects your Cardians; burns on their draw.
Synchro Tuner: draws and summons a Cardian; makes materials Level 2.
